title: The Reality of Life
verse: What follows is the account of Esau (also known as Edom).
observation: There is an uncomfortable reality that no one wants to talk about. When we read through this chapter, many people confess to skipping over many of the names. The reason for this is because these names mean nothing to us. They appear to be little more than a means to continue the family line. They are another link in the chain that eventually gets to another prominent figure. There are many more “links” than prominent figures. The uncomfortable reality is that you and I will more than likely be a “link” and not a “prominent” figure. However, we need to realize that God knows where we fit. Every one of these people were necessary for the “chain” to continue. If one of these people is missing, if they are not making sure the chain continues, if they do not continue teaching the next generation the importance of continuing the chain, the entire chain could be broken. If you ever feel like you do not matter and you do not have a purpose, zoom out and see that you are vital to the chain. Without you, the chain will be broken. Don’t just live for yourself, live for those who have come before you and those who will come after you. Do not let the chain of God’s faithfulness in your family be broken.
application: How can you be faithful in honoring your “place in the chain” today?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for letting us be part of Your generational plan.
